title: Dig a staircase down to a target relative Y safely

order.text: creuse un escalier pour descendre de ${drop} blocs depuis ici, sans te faire mal

notes: Solid stone to depth 16 with no fluids, caves or falling blocks. Facing south, seven steps remain inside the arena. Relative-Y until works for any runner origin; descend defaults to ten blocks, beyond the stopping depth. Surface respawn is safe.
